message.bananacreate.takedown: %s was taken down for copyright infringement
item.bananacreate.gorilla_arms.desc: Hydraulic arms: more damage, knockback, reach and fast mining. You move a bit slower.
item.bananacreate.mantis_blades.desc: Retractable forearm blades: +damage, +attack speed and +reach when extended. Dash to the entity you look at (up to 15 blocks).
item.bananacreate.projectile_launcher.de: Shoulder launcher. Uses 1 gunpowder per mini rocket.
item.bananacreate.monowire.desc: Monomolecular wire on the wrist: lashes in a straight line and pulls targets. Also works as a grappling hook for Spider-Man style travel.
item.bananacreate.monowire.key: [B] Lash  ·  [R] Grapple (R again or sneak to release)
message.bananacreate.too_weak: You are too weak for surgery.
item.bananacreate.banana.desc: Food and ammo for the Banana Cannon. Grows on banana leaves.
item.bananacreate.green_banana.desc: Picked early from the leaves. Ingredient for Banana Alloy and Cells.
item.bananacreate.golden_banana.desc: Regeneration and absorption when eaten. 4% when harvesting ripe bananas, or 1 banana + 3 gold sheets. Base of the Cosmic Banana.
item.bananacreate.banana_handle.desc: Handle for banana tools. Made from banana planks.
item.bananacreate.banana_alloy.desc: Create heated basin: iron + zinc + 2 Pulp + 1 Green Banana (makes 2). Tool heads and base of the Cell.
item.bananacreate.banana_cell.desc: The addon's energy. Sequenced Assembly (2 loops) on the Alloy: copper sheet, Pulp, Green Banana and press. Almost everything needs it.
item.bananacreate.banana_core.desc: Concentrated energy. Sequenced Assembly (2 loops) on a Brass Casing: Cell, Precision Mechanism, Red Banana and press.
item.bananacreate.banana_sword.desc: 20% chance the target slips: launched forward and slowed for 2s.
item.bananacreate.banana_cannon.desc: Right click fires a banana (uses 1 banana from your inventory). The banana leaves a peel on the ground.
item.bananacreate.blood_vial.desc: Bottled blood. Comes out of the Blood Centrifuge.
item.bananacreate.blood_bucket.desc: Bucket of blood. Fills Create tanks and pipes.
item.bananacreate.blood_blade.desc: Each hit steals 1 heart of health from the target.
item.bananacreate.otherside_eye.desc: Right click makes everything within 24 blocks glow for 10s. 15s cooldown.
item.bananacreate.titan_syringe.desc: Right click a hostile mob: lightning falls, it swells and bursts into steam, becoming a titan (6x bigger). Uses a Red Banana.
item.bananacreate.copyright_hammer.desc: 3 hits on the same target and it is removed for copyright infringement.
item.bananacreate.chrome_plate.desc: Create iron sheet + Banana Pulp (Sequenced Assembly: deployer and press). Base of all cyberware.
item.bananacreate.neural_chip.desc: Circuit for cyberware and machines. Needs Knowledge Essence and a Banana Cell.
item.bananacreate.chrome_arm_blades.desc: Chrome sword. Each hit applies Wither for 3s.
item.bananacreate.overclock_injector.des: Right click: Speed, Haste and Strength for 1 minute. Costs 3 hearts.
item.bananacreate.goblin_hair_tuft.desc: Dropped by Mini Goblins. Pressed into a Hair Plate.
item.bananacreate.hair_plate.desc: Pressed goblin hair. Used in the Goblin Hair Sword.
item.bananacreate.goblin_hair_sword.desc: Fast attacks. Each hit makes the target dizzy (Nausea).
item.bananacreate.chrome_scalpel.desc: Removes an installed implant and gives the item back.
item.bananacreate.mini_rocket.desc: Ammo for the shoulder Projectile Launcher.
item.bananacreate.death_essence.desc: Dropped by monsters killed in the Death Siphon. Also made from bone via Haunting.
item.bananacreate.chaos_shard.desc: Chaos shard. Made via Haunting (fan over soul fire) from amethyst.
item.bananacreate.fear_essence.desc: Fear essence. Made via Haunting from spider eyes.
item.bananacreate.knowledge_essence.desc: Knowledge essence. Made via Haunting from books.
block.bananacreate.banana_peel.desc: Anyone who steps on it slips and is flung forward (sneak to avoid). Disappears after one slip.
block.bananacreate.banana_leaves.desc: Banana tree canopy. Right click to harvest: green banana (green bunch) or ripe banana (yellow bunch; 12% red, 4% golden).
block.bananacreate.banana_sapling.desc: Plant to grow a tall banana tree with a palm-like crown and hanging bunches.
block.bananacreate.chrome_casing.desc: Chrome casing, used in machines and implants.
block.bananacreate.servo_arm.desc: Decorative robotic arm. Points where it was placed.
block.bananacreate.blood_extractor.desc: Kinetic machine: spins to hurt mobs on top and fill the blood tank.
block.bananacreate.blood_centrifuge.desc: Kinetic machine: takes blood from pipes and makes Blood Vials.
block.bananacreate.titan_treadmill.desc: Kinetic generator: traps ONE nearby titan (6 block range) and makes it walk in circles on top. 32 RPM. Killing the titan stops it.
block.bananacreate.chaos_dynamo.desc: Kinetic generator with random RPM and direction. Discharges at peaks.
block.bananacreate.death_siphon.desc: Kinetic machine: pulls and drains monsters. Those who die become Death Essence.
block.bananacreate.fear_seal.desc: Kinetic machine: repels and weakens monsters. Radius grows with RPM.
message.bananacreate.dash_blocked: No room to reach the target
block.bananacreate.implant_table.desc: Right-click opens the interface: place an implant and close it. It spins in 3D above the table; click the table to install it. Sneak + click swaps the implant.
block.bananacreate.implant_removal_table: Right-click opens the list of installed implants. Click one to remove it (the item returns to you).
gui.bananacreate.removal_hint: Click an implant to remove it
message.bananacreate.use_table: Implants are installed at the Implant Table
tooltip.bananacreate.implant_table: Install at the Implant Table (remove at the Removal Table).
item.bananacreate.red_banana.desc: Rare: 12% when harvesting ripe bananas, or bought from the Mini Goblin. Gives Strength when eaten. Used in the Banana Core and Titan Syringe.
item.bananacreate.rotten_banana.desc: Banana + Haunting (fan over soul fire). Eating it gives Hunger and Poison. Used in the Death Siphon and Fear Seal.
item.bananacreate.cosmic_banana.desc: Final material. Sequenced Assembly on a Golden Banana with an ender pearl and all 4 essences. Every implant uses one.
item.bananacreate.banana_pulp.desc: Banana ground in a Create Millstone (ripe gives 2, green gives 1). Base of the Alloy, Cell and Chrome Plate.
item.bananacreate.incomplete_banana_core: Intermediate step of the Banana Core Sequenced Assembly.
item.bananacreate.incomplete_cosmic_bana: Intermediate step of the Cosmic Banana Sequenced Assembly.
item.bananacreate.incomplete_chrome_plat: Intermediate step of the Chrome Plate Sequenced Assembly.
item.bananacreate.banana_pickaxe.desc: Mines like iron. 6% chance to drop a Green Banana per block.
item.bananacreate.banana_axe.desc: Chops like iron. 6% chance to drop a Green Banana per block.
item.bananacreate.banana_shovel.desc: Digs like iron. 6% chance to drop a Green Banana per block.
item.bananacreate.banana_hoe.desc: Tills like iron. 6% chance to drop a Green Banana per block.
block.bananacreate.banana_log.desc: Banana tree trunk. Makes Banana Planks (4 per log).
block.bananacreate.banana_planks.desc: Banana planks. Make the Banana Handle used by the tools.
Spawns a Mini Goblin: a trader selling Plates, Red, Rotten and Golden Bananas.
Spawns Kasane Teto: trades items, sings and dances. When attacked, she fires sonic bursts.
item.bananacreate.banana_relic.desc: Use on Banana Planks to summon the Banana King. Be careful!
message.bananacreate.banana_king.already: A Banana King is already nearby!
message.bananacreate.banana_king.line0: Who summoned the big banana?! Did you bring snacks?
message.bananacreate.banana_king.line2: Peel on the floor, slip for sure!
message.bananacreate.banana_king.line3: This bunch is as big as my pride!
message.bananacreate.banana_king.line4: Come dance with me, peeled one!
message.bananacreate.banana_king.line6: Your armor can't protect you from bad jokes!
message.bananacreate.banana_king.line7: I rotted with dignity... peel away my legacy.
